Name: (FS) Teddy's Pacifiers
Author: teddybeaw
Description:
[center]﻿Fashion sense mod that adds 54 base pacifiers to Stardew Valley.
Four of which custom designs, nine in cow print, and the rest in basic colours.
All basic colours also come with a half n half design and a handle, so you can customise to your heart's content; and if you want a design I haven't provided, you're free to use these ones as a base. So long as I'm credited and maybe you show it off to me.

The intent of this mod is sfw age regression and the babycore aesthetic
[url=https://agereinformation.carrd.co/]Consider reading more on the topic here![/url]﻿ [/center][center][/center]
